bead.title: CL-007c Archive raw demo session captures
bead.description: Archive only the raw demo JSONL captures approved by CL-004 row CL-004.17: demos/sessions/demo-read.jsonl, demo-edit.jsonl, and demo-bash.jsonl. Preserve the published website cast assets and keep demos/record.sh usable.
bead.acceptance: The three raw JSONL captures are moved out of demos/sessions into docs/research/archive/ or an equivalent archive path; website/static/demos/*.cast remains untouched; demos/record.sh still has a valid target directory behavior; rg shows no active references to the old JSONL paths outside cleanup/research history; bash -n demos/record.sh passes; close notes or commit cite CL-004.17.
